name: reverse-engineer a compiled binary's behavior via observation/decompilation
definition: determine which rendering/scene operation the target program performs by observing its input-output behavior or disassembling/decoding its logic.
failure_mode: an incomplete reverse model produces significant deviation past the high similarity threshold

name: round-trip a resharded directory back to an exact original tree
definition: Write a decompression script that, in-place, reconstructs the original file names and byte content exactly from a resharded directory.
failure_mode: Any name or hash mismatch fails the reconstruction assertion.

name: run the target application with the derived secret
definition: Invoke the application passing the recovered secret so it executes its body and produces the side-effect output file.
failure_mode: Abstaining from running leaves no output file at all.

name: selectively stream a single archive member without expanding the whole archive
definition: Extract only the wanted file's bytes to stdout rather than materializing the full archive on disk, avoiding sensitive payloads.
failure_mode: Extracting everything leaves sensitive entries on disk and likely clobbers the large coexisting log.
